# Check: upstream terminal-image.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/terminal-image.test.ts

## Subject
Image-protocol detection (iTerm2, Kitty) and terminal-capability detection (hyperlinks).

## Upstream test count (approx)
35

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- detects iTerm2 image escape sequence at start/middle/end/in-long-line/minimal form
- detects Kitty image escape sequence at start/with padding/with text before
- detects image sequences in very long lines (304k+ chars)
- detects image sequences when terminal does not support images
- detects sequences with ANSI codes before and after
- does not detect in plain text, ANSI-only, cursor-movement-only, partial iTerm2, partial Kitty, empty, or newline-only lines
- detects both Kitty and iTerm2 in same line; multiple text/image segments
- does not falsely detect image in file-path lines containing keywords
- defaults hyperlinks:false for unknown terminals
- forces hyperlinks:false under tmux even if outer terminal supports OSC 8
- forces hyperlinks:false when TERM starts with 'tmux' or 'screen'
- enables hyperlinks for Ghostty, Kitty, WezTerm, iTerm2, VSCode
- hyperlink(text, url) wraps text in OSC 8 open and close sequences
- preserves ANSI styling inside the hyperlink
- works with empty text and file:// URIs

## Upstream dependencies
detectCapabilities, hyperlink, isImageLine from ../src/terminal-image.js

## Upstream notes
isImageLine uses includes() (not startsWith). detectCapabilities() checks env vars (TERM, TERM_PROGRAM, KITTY_WINDOW_ID, WEZTERM_PANE, GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR, ITERM_SESSION_ID, TMUX). Hyperlink format: \\x1b]8;;URL\\x1b\\text\\x1b]8;;\\x1b\\. tmux and screen always disable hyperlinks regardless of TERM_PROGRAM.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

comments.text:
# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/terminal-image.test.ts (30 tests across isImageLine, detectCapabilities, hyperlink)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs (17 tests; 3 overlap upstream, 14 are extra encode/fallback coverage)

## MAPPED (shallow)

| Upstream | Elixir |
|---|---|
| isImageLine detects Kitty image escape at start | "detects Kitty image lines" |
| isImageLine detects iTerm2 image escape at start | "detects iTerm2 image lines" |
| isImageLine false for plain text | "returns false for regular text" |
| hyperlink wraps text in OSC 8 | "wraps text in OSC 8 hyperlink" (asserts contains, not exact format) |

## UNMAPPED

### isImageLine (14 unmapped)
- iTerm2 escape with text before it
- iTerm2 escape in middle of long line
- iTerm2 escape at end of line
- minimal iTerm2 sequence (`"\e]1337;File=:\x07"`)
- Kitty escape with text before it
- Kitty escape with padding (leading/trailing whitespace)
- 304k+ char line with image sequence (regression)
- image sequence detected even when terminal has no image support
- ANSI codes before / ANSI codes after image sequence
- ANSI codes mixed with iTerm2 and with Kitty
- lines with only ANSI codes → false
- cursor-movement-only lines → false
- partial iTerm2 (`"]1337;File"` without ESC) → false
- partial Kitty (`"_G"` without ESC) → false
- empty line → false
- newline-only lines → false
- mixed Kitty+iTerm2 line → true
- multiple image segments in one line → true
- file-path line with keywords (`"/path/to/File_1337_backup/image.jpg"`) → false

### detectCapabilities (9 unmapped — ours only asserts shape)
- unknown terminal → hyperlinks=false, images=null
- under TMUX → hyperlinks=false, images=null (even with TERM_PROGRAM=ghostty)
- TERM starting with "tmux" → hyperlinks=false
- TERM starting with "screen" → hyperlinks=false
- TERM_PROGRAM=ghostty → hyperlinks=true
- KITTY_WINDOW_ID set → hyperlinks=true
- WEZTERM_PANE set → hyperlinks=true
- TERM_PROGRAM=iterm.app → hyperlinks=true
- TERM_PROGRAM=vscode → hyperlinks=true

### hyperlink (3 unmapped)
- exact format match: `hyperlink("click me", "https://example.com") == "\e]8;;https://example.com\e\\click me\e]8;;\e\\"` (our test only asserts `=~` containment)
- preserves ANSI styling inside (and wrapping starts/ends with OSC 8 open/close)
- works with empty text (exact output)
- works with file:// URIs

## N/A / EXTRA

Elixir adds encode_kitty, encode_iterm2, get_png_dimensions, calculate_image_rows, image_fallback coverage — useful beyond upstream scope, retain.

## Action

Compliance ticket: port 26 missing upstream tests. Needs an env-overriding test helper (like upstream `withEnv`) that saves/restores TERM, TERM_PROGRAM, COLORTERM, TMUX, KITTY_WINDOW_ID, GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR, WEZTERM_PANE, ITERM_SESSION_ID. Verify detect_capabilities/0 caches or does not cache per call — upstream uses `resetCapabilitiesCache` — mirror that semantics if ours caches.
